root_cause_limit: Conditional probability failure is observed. Failing transport/probability vector was not saved; zero-row normalization versus nonfinite-state propagation cannot be distinguished. Prior support loss and terminal Sinkhorn numerical warnings are consistent with finite-precision degradation, not proof of the first invalid operation.
source_scope: Removing only monitor entry/finally hooks recovers native semantic AST exactly in every trial. Inner Sinkhorn source is the previously preserved same-version/environment-path source; no new environment query. No wrapper fault appears in these tracebacks/source checks.
timing_policy: solver_seconds is the last completed callback, a lower bound on failed solver work. Runner and launcher elapsed include rejected work at different scopes; do not add them. Unclassified residual is not a measured failed-iteration duration.
reporting_policy: Preserve failed status, +inf final penalty, actual earlier checkpoints and missing-window denominators. Never extend last output to300s, invent final float64 loss, claim convergence, retune or replace replication. Inner counts remain unknown.
